values.note: Books online through Firefly (the county's own engine); walk-ins and questions by phone. Check in at the office first.

booking.source: https://townsbluffpark.org/faq/ ('Reservations can be made online here: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/...'; 'Book online or call (912) 379-9303 for walk-ins and questions') + Firefly search page (max search date 10-29-2027 on 2026-10-29), read 2026-10-29

note: Jeff Davis County park on a bluff at the meeting of the Ocmulgee, Oconee and Altamaha rivers, 45 Riverwood Trail, Hazlehurst; also primitive tent sites and two air-conditioned yurts, a boat launch for paddlers, hiking trails, a playground, a shooting range and a heritage museum on the river's timber-rafting history. Max 2 vehicles per site. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its Firefly engine (the searches went through; the reCAPTCHA is invisible): 23 RV sites, back-in and pull-through, electric (no amperage/water/sewer stated), heated bathhouses, coin laundry; $35 a night at every RV site on 2026 and 2027 dates, site 24 $45; window 365 days. booking.platform 'reserveamerica' (derived from note prose) was wrong -> operator with the Firefly url. Pin matches Google (4.4 stars / 187 reviews, phone matches). The RV loops sit ~100-250 m back from the Altamaha in pines; no waterfront lead.
